give:
Create a production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas derived from the approved team cooperation UI reference (first image) and character identity reference (second image). Use the same polished 3D chibi mobile-game rendering, soft warm lighting, expressive large eyes and crisp silhouette edges. This is an INDEPENDENT ART ASSET, not a UI screenshot or cropped design page. Genuine alpha transparency, no background, no panels, NO TEXT, no grid lines, no labels, no borders, no circles or decorative scenery.

Exactly NINE distinct waist-up sprites in a strict regular 3 columns by 3 rows matrix. Square 1536x1536 canvas. Each sprite entirely confined to its own equal 512x512 logical cell, at least 32px transparent margin on all four sides. No anatomy or prop crosses cell boundary, same scale and head size; no extra sprites. Do NOT render checkerboard pixels.
Top row left-to-right: 0 Tangtang brown-haired boy blue hoodie; 1 Keke brown-haired girl high ponytail, white flower, yellow hoodie; 2 Ajie boy green backwards cap and black round glasses, green hoodie.
Middle row: 3 Naicha girl pink knit cap, long brown hair, pink hoodie; 4 Akai boy short black tousled hair, black-and-white hoodie; 5 Yuanyuan girl PURPLE hair with small yellow star hairclip, lilac clothes.
Bottom row: 6 Doudou youthful child with beige bucket hat, short brown hair and yellow shirt; 7 Maomao girl long dark brown hair, white sailor top and blue bow; 8 friendly silver robot with rounded blue-lit face, two eyes and small antenna, silver torso and blue accents. Preserve all identities and unique clothing from the reference, do not recolor by team.

POSE FOR ALL NINE: warm encouraging smile, three-quarter view slightly facing viewer's RIGHT; extend BOTH hands toward the right at chest height, holding ONE SMALL red coin pouch with gold coins peeking out as in the approved left hero. Pouch belongs to this donor sprite; recipient will be drawn separately. Arms and pouch must remain inside cell. Natural five-finger hands, no trophy, no arrows.
